name: Ellis: The Anxious Lion
source:
One winter night, you find a lion sleeping under your house. He seems scared of you, but you don't know why.

There's something very unusual about him. Do you want to find out what it is?

He's quite meek. You could always pick on him, too.

[from [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/ellis-the-anxious-lion]itch.io[/url]]
